description:
Public view returned by `GET /api/desk/settings/ai-policy`. Carries no
secret (the policy never held one).

exec_pty_enabled.description: Machine-wide local switch for ordinary one-shot PTY execution.

exec_pty_supported.description: Whether this host build/runtime can execute an ordinary one-shot PTY.

interactive_elevation_enabled.description: Machine-wide local switch for bounded sudo/doas PTY execution.

interactive_elevation_supported.description:
Whether this host currently has the root ServiceDaemon containment
required for interactive elevation.

max_command_runtime_seconds.description: Total wall-time ceiling for one AI command, in seconds.

max_concurrent_executions.description: How many commands may run on this device at once.
